conclusions.statement: MDB and OMF project linked _ORG_BIN object attributes targeting MCBR. A readable nonempty binNameUTF8 wins; legacy binName is used when the modern value is absent, empty or unreadable. Equal-priority conflicting modern values remain unresolved.
proof: Genuine non-English MDB + matching bin and header identities
Genuine MC2026 audio MDB + physical header/bin identity pairs
Genuine BLACK OMF + same-folder MDB pair

conclusions.statement: The non-English MDB supplies Nön English bin náme™ 你好 漢; matching physical MXF header supplies no Original Bin observation, while the matching bin independently corroborates the same original-bin name and UID. AVB use here is evidence only; it is not target enrichment.

The genuine WAVE and AIFF-C headers supply no Original Bin observations (NotRead/CoverageNotEstablished/Unknown). Their same-folder MDB supplies WAVE(OMF) and AIFF-C(OMF); matching bins corroborate. A genuine BLACK OMF header supplies Media Slides and agrees with its same-folder MDB. A genuine FORMAT OMF and its MDB remain without a selected Original Bin.

Current Mxf projection has no OriginalBin mapping. All four inspected complete MXF headers returned NotRead/CoverageNotEstablished/Unknown with no Original Bin observation. None of their interpreted TaggedValue.Name sets contains _ORG_BIN. These checks do not prove every private MXF object/key or every Avid producer omits Original Bin.

All six inspected PMRs produce no Original Bin observation and report Absent/NotStoredByFormat/Unknown from projectPmr default coverage. Known supported PMR record layouts project filename, project and file/master IDs. This is not a published universal PMR field-schema claim and does not settle MDB/header coverage.

headerFallbackMissingProperties requires an extra header read for unresolved Original Bin only when selected agreement is Conflicting. Missing or uncovered Original Bin alone does not trigger a header read, unlike Copland C12/C40.

conclusions.status: Verified no generic missing-value absence proof
conclusions.statement: MDB/OMF explicitly record OriginalBin property coverage when a linked MCBR object is reached. Missing Original Bin elsewhere in the checked genuine sources remains NotRead/CoverageNotEstablished. A complete reader outcome alone is not sufficient to report checked absence.

neededImplementationChanges.change: Replace the conflict-only Original Bin header gate with the settled value/coverage checklist: use the preferred identity-matched MDB value when present; if the field is still required and not established inapplicable, a missing/unresolved value follows the next allowed source even when absence was checked in the MDB. Allow the one authorized header fallback and leave the terminal unavailable result explicit when sources are exhausted or header coverage is unsupported.
neededImplementationChanges.limit: One bounded fallback; no AVB enrichment, whole-database expansion, cross-folder lookup or indefinite retry.

neededImplementationChanges.scope: Original Bin compact projection and status
neededImplementationChanges.change: Retain the existing understood _ORG_BIN-to-MCBR mapping, UTF-8/legacy precedence, owning-file/master association and compact result. Record checked absence only after a complete understood relevant attribute graph establishes it; preserve NotRead/unsupported/incomplete/unreadable in every other case.
neededImplementationChanges.limit: Do not treat a missing observation, a complete parse, a bin filename or binary string presence as proof of absence or as a replacement Bin value.

neededImplementationChanges.change: Keep MXF Original Bin coverage explicitly unresolved. Adding a mapper requires a genuine MXF that records this fact plus established native key/type and owning-package relationship. Existing MDB/AVB MCBR spellings do not by themselves provide an MXF mapping.
neededImplementationChanges.limit: No justified new MXF parser mapping was identified in this bounded verification. Do not mark this as implemented or checked absence.

neededImplementationChanges.change: Preserve the genuine non-English MDB/PMR/MXF pair, both MC2026 audio MDB/header/bin pairs, and BLACK OMF/MDB pair as regression specimens for compact selection and coverage semantics. Ensure the bounded fallback test distinguishes absence from unsupported coverage.
neededImplementationChanges.limit: AVB regression specimen may corroborate stored values; scanned row metadata must not be enriched from loaded bins under C16.

nativeBinaryEvidence.method: Fresh read-only exact null-delimited ASCII byte search of the installed universal libameLibrary. Offsets are physical file offsets, not virtual addresses; no Avid code executed.
nativeBinaryEvidence.meaningLimit: Native name occurrence corroborates spelling. It does not establish MXF storage, object ownership, encoding or standardized OMF meaning.
